#include <cstdio>
#include <algorithm>

int go(long long n) {
    if (n == 0) return 0;
    long long k = 1;
    int cnt = 1;
    while (k * 10 + 1 < n) {
        k = k * 10 + 1;
        cnt++;
    }
    int option1 = go(n % k) + (n / k) * cnt;
    long long next = k * 10 + 1;
    int option2 = go((next - n) % k) + (cnt + 1) + ((next - n) / k) * cnt;
    return std::min(option1, option2);
}

int main() {
    long long n;
    scanf("%lld", &n);
    printf("%d\n", go(n));
    return 0;
}
